notes: Ervo picks the right brain for each message: quick answers on a fast model, research and health questions on a deeper one with web search, long documents written in full
Ervo draws pictures: ask for a drawing, logo or wallpaper, then tap Save. It won't draw real people or anything explicit or violent
Usage is counted by Ervo's server: chats a day, research and pictures a month. Ervo Stats shows what's left, and a friendly note with See plans appears at a limit
Plans: Free, Plus ($9.99) and Pro ($19.99), with Business Starter and Growth. Upgrading opens with the app stores
Order cards say where their status comes from (what you told Ervo, your order email, or the carrier), and nothing sends you out to the store anymore
Paste an Amazon order number or any tracking number and Ervo saves a card to Files; the phone reminds you the day before and the day it should arrive
Order tracking asks once, inside Ervo, under Connected Apps
Replies start appearing within a second or two as Ervo writes
highlights: Ask Ervo to draw a picture, then tap Save
Ervo Stats shows chats, research and pictures left
Order cards are honest about what's live, and remind you when it should arrive
